    "Прачечная": {"запад": "Игровая", "восток": "Погреб"},

}

def bfs_min_transitions(graph, start):
    visited = set()
    queue = deque([(start, [])])  # (текущая комната, путь)
    visited.add(start)
    all_paths = []

        current_room, path = queue.popleft()

                visited.add(next_room)
                queue.append((next_room, path + [direction]))
